text:
Ivy (Marketing): Quick thread for Strandlight case production + 30s testimonial + webinar tie-in. Need quote + logo consent, localization (EN/KO/FR), and inbound lead routing to HubSpot by EOD Monday.
Sam (Growth): Webinar planned 2026-11-09 17:00 UTC. Promo live 2026-10-31. Deliverables: 30s organic, 15s paid, 6s bumper. UTM: utm_campaign=strandlight_case_q4. HubSpot form -> SFDC campaign -> 7-day nurture.
Noah (CS): Customer sent a candid quote but it includes a monthly spend figure and an internal ticket number. Legal flagged the ticket and revenue as sensitive. I'll request a sanitized quote and the DocuSign for logo/quote consent.
Aisha (Legal): We can't publish ticket IDs or dollar amounts without explicit opt-in. Recommend replacing spend with a percentage or qualitative wording. Also need explicit logo permission.
Ivy (Marketing): Ok—Noah, ask them for: (a) a publication-friendly sentence that keeps the impact, e.g., "% reduction in inference cost" instead of $X, (b) logo use checkbox, (c) permission to use a 30s clip excerpt in paid ads.
Noah (CS): Sent DocuSign with checkboxes: logo, quote, paid-ads-use. Also requested a sample sentence: "We reduced inference costs by ~37% after moving to Redwood Dedicated." ETA 8 hours.
Sam (Growth): OpsBot, pre-create the SFDC campaign skeleton and HubSpot nurture so we can wire submissions immediately when the form goes live. Name suggestions: Strandlight_Case_Q4_2026 and Strandlight_Nurture_7d.
OpsBot: Draft SFDC campaign created: "Strandlight_Case_Q4_2026". HubSpot workflow created: "Strandlight_Nurture_7d" (placeholder). Use /ops finalize to activate.
Ivy (Marketing): Creative brief: open 4s brand lockup, 21s quote highlight, 5s CTA. Burned subtitles EN/KO/FR. Lower third: "Strandlight  Head of SRE, Clara Montoya" (if they prefer anonymized title we'll update). Also need a 600-word blog linking to a benchmark appendix.
Sam (Growth): Can research confirm the comparative numbers we want cited? I don't want to publish unverified latency or cost deltas. Pinged R&D for verification.
Noah (CS): DocuSign returned signed for logo and quote, customer replaced $ number with "~37% reduction in inference costs" and asked we use "Senior SRE" rather than exact title. They asked to avoid ms-level p99 numbers.
Aisha (Legal): Language looks good; approved replacement with percentage and anonymized title. No PII. :thumbsup: Confirmed we can mention percentage improvements only.
Ivy (Marketing): Great. Sam, confirm ad budget owner and boost window. Sam, also make 15s cut for paid with alternate CTA.
Sam (Growth): Budget owner growth@redwood.com. Boost 10/31-11/07. Creating paid audiences: APAC tech execs + EMEA platform leads. I'll attach audience specs when creatives are ready.
Ivy (Marketing): OpsBot, please queue the pre-publish checklist when assets uploaded. Checklist to include: render master, export 30s/15s/6s, burn subs EN/KO/FR, create burned captions for paid cuts, upload to CDN s3://redwood-marketing/strandlight/, finalize SFDC campaign, activate HubSpot nurture, schedule blog + social, set embargo for case PDF 2026-11-09T16:00:00Z (1 hour before webinar).
OpsBot: Pre-publish checklist queued. Items: strandlight_master.mov, strandlight_30s.mp4, strandlight_15s.mp4, strandlight_6s.mp4, en.srt, ko.srt, fr.srt, s3://redwood-marketing/strandlight/, SFDC Strandlight_Case_Q4_2026, HubSpot Strandlight_Nurture_7d, blog /content/case-studies/strandlight, social posts ready.
Ivy (Marketing): Scheduling final review 2026-10-31 08:00Z. Please add to calendars. Noah, monitor customer channel during publish. Aisha, be on standby for any last-minute legal flags.
Noah (CS): Added calendar. I'll be online during publish.
Aisha (Legal): Standing by.
Sam (Growth): Marked. Once assets are uploaded, post links and OpsBot will run final checks.
Ivy (Marketing): Thanks team. Closing thread  please confirm when checklist clears. :rocket:
